scenes.say: Your shop is closed. Who answers?
scenes.title: Closed? Still answering.

scenes.say: I'm Vee. This is our voice receptionist.
scenes.title: Meet Vee

scenes.say: A customer asks, in English or Arabic.
scenes.title: English or Arabic
chat: Do you have a chocolate cake?

scenes.say: It answers from your catalog and shows the product.
scenes.title: Your catalog, your answers
chat: Yes. Here it is, from today's menu.

scenes.say: Closed or busy, your shop answers. Message us DEMO.
scenes.title: Message us DEMO

caption:
Your shop is closed, and a customer has a question.

Our voice receptionist answers from your own catalog, in English or Arabic, shows the product and takes the order.

Message us DEMO to see it.
